turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
Take your time.
I booked a session with a debt charity and an adviser called Hilary said there are repayment plans.
Take your time.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I keep coming back to it.
What went through your mind then?
Meera still talks about leaving, and says she does not trust me with money any more.
Mm-hm. Go on.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I think so, yes.
And how was that for you?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Saturday's match was hard, I had a strong urge to bet on the second half.
Mm-hm. Go on.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. I keep coming back to it.
What happened next?
I gave Meera all of my bank cards and she now controls the household account.
Tell me more about that.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Take your time.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
